title: Grateful Dead Live at Uptown Theater on 1979-12-03
source: 2 source matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:29434), Recording Info: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k); Set 2: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: Set 1: Dat (Sony D8) -> M-Audio Dio2448 -> Samplitude Professional v8.0 -> FLAC; Set 2: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v8.0 -> FLAC, Transferred and Edited By Charlie Miller and Audience (shnid:83611),Recording by Ira Frisch: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Sennheiser 421s + Sennheiser 441> Nakamichi 550 Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition> (dither/downsample)> FLAC * from 1st generation cassette from same master; master played back on Nak 550> Nak 250

ai_review.summary: An excellent matrix recording captures a blistering hot show highlighted by a soaring Terrapin Station, while the Wharf Rat feels mediocre.
ai_review.review: The Dusborne‑crafted matrix source is praised as crystal‑clear and full‑throttle, delivering a richer sound than the raw SBD. The performance is described as immense with Phil’s thunderous bass and Jerry’s ferocious guitar work, though only Terrapin Station truly shines and the Wharf Rat is seen as lackluster.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight both an outstanding matrix recording and a high‑energy show, while the lone 3‑star review offers mild criticism; weighted scoring yields ~4.6 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the matrix source "absolutely incredible" and note it adds audience ambience to a clean SBD, eliminating hollowness and providing full‑throttle mayhem. No major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as a blistering, hot performance with high energy throughout; the matrix mix enhances the flow, though only Terrapin truly stands out.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is intense and "picking his brains out" from start to finish; one reviewer notes typical thinness on SBD but praises this recording for delivering full power.
band_member_comments.Phil: Provides thundering highlights on the bottom end, adding depth to the performance.
